Archivi digitali di Framework Archaeolog: Framework Archaeology digital archives as downloaded: plan of the interventions (Stansted.shp or «T5 Volume 2.shp»), ContextData.csv and the other CSV tables, the terrain model. The units have no levels: cuts go down by the recorded depth from the excavation surface, derived from the terrain lowered by 30 cm (ploughsoil) or, for Heathrow, from the 1943 topography plus the truncation model.
